name: Pacific County, WA
findings: Pacific County has 55 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pacific County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Pacific County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
